ርሡኣኒነ: ርሡእ — our old men (noun (?), plural ርሡኣን + -ነ '1cp our'); sense uncertain (?)
ሕፃናቲነ: ሕፃን — our little ones, children (noun, plural ሕፃናት, stem ሕፃናቲ- + -ነ '1cp our')
አንብዓ: አንብዕ — tears of (noun, collective 'tears', construct አንብዓ 'tears of'; አንብዓ አንስቲያነ)
አንስቲያነ: ብእሲት — our women (noun, plural አንስት, stem አንስቲያ- + -ነ '1cp our')
ወማሰነት: ማሰን — and ruin (ወ- 'and' + noun ማሰነት 'ruin, destruction'; it stands before ሀገርነ in the sense 'ruin of our country', though a construct ending would be expected); form uncertain (?)
ተፍጻሜተ: ተፍጻሜት — end of (noun, construct 'end of'; እስከ ተፍጻሜተ መዋዕሊነ)
ተነሥተ: ተነሠተ — was taken away (3ms perfect, Gt stem, passive of ነሠተ 'take away, seize', as in ነሠትካ above; if from ነሥአ the spelling would be ተነሥአ) (?)
ለወለተ: ወለት — of the daughter of (ለ- 'of, for' + noun, fem., construct 'daughter of')
ክብርት: ክቡር — honored (adjective, fem. ክብርት; apposition to the daughter of Zion)
ወዐብየ: ዐብየ — and it grew, became great (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, ʿ-b-y)
ኅስርት: ኅሱር — lacking, deficient (adjective, fem. ኅስርት; apposition to the daughter of Ethiopia)
ተምዕዐ: ተምዕዐ — he was angry (3ms perfect, Gt stem, root m-ʿ-ʿ)
ይሣሀል: ሣሀለ — he will have mercy, show mercy (3ms imperfect, root ś-h-l, cf. ሣህል 'mercy')
አስተራኰሰ: አስተራኰሰ — he made unclean (?) (3ms perfect, ast- stem of a root r-k-s, cf. ርኵስ 'unclean'; lemma and sense uncertain) (?)
ያነጽሕ: አንጽሐ — he will cleanse (3ms imperfect, causative of ንጽሐ 'be pure')
ይትቃወማ: ተቃወመ — he will oppose her (3ms imperfect, tafāʿala stem, root q-w-m, + -ኣ '3fs her', anticipating ለምክሩ)
ለምክሩ: ምክር — his plan, counsel (ለ- marking the object + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
የአብያ: አበየ — he will refuse her/it (3ms imperfect, G, ʾ-b-y + -ኣ '3fs it', anticipating ለኅሊናሁ)
ለኅሊናሁ: ኅሊና — his purpose, thought (ለ- marking the object + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
አኅሰረ: አኅሰረ — he caused to lack, diminished (3ms perfect, causative of ኅሰረ 'lack')
ዘያከብር: አክበረ — who honors (ዘ- 'who' + 3ms imperfect, causative of ከበረ)
ዘያገብእ: አግብአ — who brings back, restores (ዘ- 'who' + 3ms imperfect, causative of ገብአ 'return')
ጸልአ: ጸልአ — he hated (3ms perfect, G, ṣ-l-ʾ)
ዘያፈቅር: አፍቀረ — who loves (ዘ- 'who' + 3ms imperfect, causative; ፍቅር 'love')
ስምነዮምሰ: ዮም — today indeed (adverb ዮም + contrastive -ሰ), written fused with the preceding ስምነ 'our name' (ስም + -ነ '1cp our')
ተመነነ: መነነ — was despised (3ms perfect, Gt stem ተመነነ, passive of መነነ 'despise'); in በኀጢአትነ ተመነነ the same spelling stands for 1cp 'we were despised' (= ተመነንነ, one ን written)
ውስጥ: ውስጥ — inside, within (adverb / noun; ሰብአ ውስጥ 'men of the inside, insiders')
ተሰደድነ: ሰደደ — we were driven out, expelled (1cp perfect, Gt stem ተሰደደ, passive of ሰደደ)
በኀጢአትነ: ኀጢአት — by our sin (በ- 'by, through' + noun + -ነ '1cp our')
አበይዋ: አበየ — they refused her (3mp perfect, G, ʾ-b-y + -ኣ '3fs her', ንጽሕ)
ለንጽሕ: ንጽሕ — purity (ለ- marking the object + noun)
ወአፍቀርዋ: አፍቀረ — and they loved her (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, causative; + -ኣ '3fs her')
ለርኵስ: ርኵስ — uncleanness, the unclean (ለ- marking the object + noun/adjective)
ወነቢያትኒ: ነቢይ — and the prophets too (ወ- 'and' + plural ነቢያት + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
ገሠጹነ: ገሠጸ — they rebuked us (3mp perfect, G, g-ś-ṣ + -ነ '1cp us')
ወኢተገሠጽነ: ተገሠጸ — and we were not corrected, not rebuked (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 1cp perfect, Gt stem, passive of ገሠጸ)
ወአስምዑነ: አስምዐ — and they made us hear, warned us (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, causative of ሰምዐ + -ነ '1cp us')
ወኢሰማዕነ: ሰምዐ — and we did not hear, did not listen (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 1cp perfect, G, s-m-ʿ)
በኀሳርነ: ኀሳር — by our loss (በ- 'by, through' + noun + -ነ '1cp our')
ተቀሠፍነ: ተቀሠፈ — we were scourged, struck (1cp perfect, Gt stem, passive of ቀሠፈ)

__broaden__.አ: አ — [ʾa], question particle (?) (written detached from the verb) · not a question particle in አ ጥፋእከ (ch. 60): the detached first syllable of አጥፋእከ (አጥፍአ 'you destroyed'), whose rest is written as the next word ጥፋእከ
__broaden__.ርሕቀ: ርሕቅ — distance, remoteness (noun, construct 'distance of'; the lemma is inferred from the form: ርሕቀት would give construct ርሕቀተ, and Dillmann is unavailable, so unconfirmed) · here a verb ርሕቀ (ርሕቀ 'was far, was distant', 3ms perfect, G, r-ḥ-q), as in ርሕቀ ሕይወቱ እምኔከ 'his life was far from you', not the construct noun
__broaden__.ደቂቅነ: ደቂቅ — our sons (plural noun + -ነ '1cp our') · 'our children' (ደቂቅ plural 'children' + -ነ '1cp our')
__broaden__.ቤት: ቤት — house (noun) · construct 'house of' (ቤት ስብሐቲከ 'house of your glory'; ሰብአ ቤት 'men of the house')
__broaden__.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
__broaden__.ዘኵሎ: ኵሉ — who (over) all (ዘ- + ኵሉ accusative; ዘኵሎ ይመልክ 'who rules all') · 'all', in loose apposition after ዘገብራ (ዘገብራ ዘኵሎ 'that made it, all'; the construction is uncertain) (?)
